packs.title: Black Khergit Camp Runtime
packs.description: Stewardship contract for the camped Black Khergit horde. The camp AI lock, hourly lifecycle, report-facing status, and player-facing consequences must agree: a pitched camp remains stationary until an explicit relocation or approach branch changes that state.

brief.summary: Keep the Black Khergit horde legible as a threatening but anchored camp, rather than a party that silently drifts because an unrelated AI branch overwrote its intent.
lore_constraints: A pitched horde camp is a deliberate occupation and must read as settled until a named relocation or approach transition occurs.
The report must describe the same live camp state that the campaign AI enforces.
acceptance_criteria: A valid camp receives ai_bhvr_hold and zero initiative from the camped-lock helper.
Only explicit relocation or approach logic may expose a movement behavior for the camp.
The hourly lifecycle and report menu continue to resolve the same Black Khergit horde ownership chain.

timeline.title: Lock camp AI
timeline.description: The camped-horde helper reasserts stationary AI before later lifecycle branches can react to explicit relocation or approach state.

timeline.title: Process hourly horde lifecycle
timeline.description: Hourly processing owns pressure, recovery, and explicit state transitions without treating camp movement as an ambient default.

contracts.description: The camped lock helper must visibly set holding behavior and zero initiative for the Black Khergit horde camp.
